title: CAMERA:
content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm tape camcorder handheld feel. POV of CHASE holding the camera herself, occasionally propping it on a rack, bench, or machine console. Hand shake, misaligned framing, delayed focus pulls, clumsy zooms, occasional face cut-off framing, imperfect shots. Camcorder never appears on screen.
LOOK:
Soft, slightly blurry tape quality, faint tape noise, bloomed highlights under gym lighting, flickering auto-exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin tones.
STYLE:
Playful, self-deprecating gym-vlog tone — genuine effort, breathless commentary, real laughs. Quick handheld cuts, energy building progressively from determined to visibly exhausted, camera slightly wobbling by the later cuts to match her shaky legs.
Character
CHASE — Korean idol , 20s. Long black hair in a high ponytail, glowing skin building up a sweat sheen as the session progresses, big expressive eyes. Slim athletic build. Modest long-sleeve athletic top, loose joggers/leggings (arms and torso fully covered), sneakers, towel around neck, no jewelry.
Setting
A gym in the evening — squat rack, leg press machine, leg curl machine, lunge space near the mirror wall, water fountain across the room, soft overhead lighting.
Storyboard (20s, 8 cuts)
(~2.5s, propped camera at squat rack, medium shot) She stands, hands on hips, psyching herself up. CHASE: "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2.5s, propped camera, squat rack) She performs a few squats, controlled breathing, racks the bar with an exhale. CHASE: "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."
(~2.5s, handheld, walking) She moves to the lunge space near the mirror, camera bouncing slightly. CHASE: "Onto lunges now, wish me luck."
(~2.5s, medium propped shot, lunges) She performs a few walking lunges, wobbling slightly on the last one, laughing at herself. CHASE: "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2.5s, propped camera, leg press machine) She settles into the leg press, pushes through a rep, face straining. CHASE: "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF) Close-up on her hands gripping the leg press handles, sweat catching the light. No dialogue — ambient gym sound only.
(~2.5s, handheld, unsteady walk) She stands up, legs visibly shaking, grabbing the rack for balance, bursting into laughter. CHASE (laughing): "Okay— my legs are actually shaking right now—"
(~3s, arm's-length selfie finish) She leans against the wall near the water fountain, catching her breath, tired grin, thumbs up. CHASE: "Okay, never doing legs again — see you guys, going to go lie down somewhere."

es.content:
CAMERA:
Sensación de videocámara DV de cinta de 16 mm, en mano. POV de CHASE sosteniendo ella misma la cámara, apoyándola ocasionalmente en un rack, un banco o la consola de una máquina. Temblor de mano, encuadre desalineado, cambios de foco tardíos, zooms torpes, encuadres que a veces cortan parte del rostro, tomas imperfectas. La videocámara nunca aparece en pantalla.
LOOK:
Calidad de cinta suave, ligeramente borrosa, leve ruido de cinta, altas luces reventadas bajo la iluminación del gimnasio, autoexposición parpadeante, contraste apagado, tonos de piel realistas.
STYLE:
Tono juguetón, autocrítico, de gym-vlog — esfuerzo genuino, comentarios entrecortados, risas reales. Cortes rápidos en mano, energía que va creciendo progresivamente desde la determinación hasta el agotamiento visible, con la cámara temblando un poco más en los últimos cortes para acompañar sus piernas inestables.
Character
CHASE — ídolo coreana, 20s. Cabello largo negro en una coleta alta, piel luminosa que va adquiriendo un brillo de sudor a medida que avanza la sesión, ojos grandes y expresivos. Complexión atlética y delgada. Top deportivo modesto de manga larga, joggers/leggings holgados (brazos y torso completamente cubiertos), zapatillas, toalla alrededor del cuello, sin joyas.
Setting
Un gimnasio por la tarde-noche — rack de sentadillas, máquina de leg press, máquina de curl de piernas, espacio para zancadas cerca de la pared de espejos, fuente de agua al otro lado de la sala, iluminación suave desde el techo.
Storyboard (20s, 8 cuts)
(~2.5s, cámara apoyada en el rack de sentadillas, plano medio) Está de pie, con las manos en las caderas, animándose mentalmente. CHASE: "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2.5s, cámara apoyada, rack de sentadillas) Hace unas cuantas sentadillas, respirando con control, vuelve a colocar la barra en el rack con un exhalar. CHASE: "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."
(~2.5s, handheld, caminando) Se mueve al espacio para zancadas cerca del espejo, la cámara rebota ligeramente. CHASE: "Onto lunges now, wish me luck."
(~2.5s, plano medio apoyado, zancadas) Hace unas cuantas zancadas caminando, tambaleándose un poco en la última, riéndose de sí misma. CHASE: "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2.5s, cámara apoyada, máquina de leg press) Se acomoda en la leg press, empuja en una repetición, con el rostro tenso por el esfuerzo. CHASE: "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2s, inserto macro, poca profundidad de campo) Primer plano de sus manos agarrando las asas de la leg press, el sudor captando la luz. Sin diálogo — solo sonido ambiente del gimnasio.
(~2.5s, handheld, caminata inestable) Se pone de pie, con las piernas visiblemente temblorosas, agarrándose al rack para mantener el equilibrio, y estalla en carcajadas. CHASE (laughing): "Okay— my legs are actually shaking right now—"
(~3s, selfie a la distancia del brazo, cierre) Se apoya contra la pared cerca de la fuente de agua, recuperando el aliento, con una sonrisa cansada y pulgar arriba. CHASE: "Okay, never doing legs again — see you guys, going to go lie down somewhere."

fr.content:
CAMÉRA :
Caméscope DV 16 mm avec une sensation de prise de vue à la main. POV de CHASE qui tient elle-même la caméra, la posant parfois sur un rack, un banc ou la console d’une machine. Tremblements de main, cadrage désaligné, mises au point retardées, zooms maladroits, cadrage coupant parfois le visage, plans imparfaits. Le caméscope n’apparaît jamais à l’écran.

LOOK :
Qualité de bande douce, légèrement floue, léger bruit de bande, hautes lumières qui bavent sous l’éclairage de la salle, auto-exposition vacillante, contraste atténué, tons de peau réalistes.

STYLE :
Ton de vlog de salle de sport ludique et auto-dérisoire — effort sincère, commentaires essoufflés, vrais rires. Coups de coupe rapides à la main, énergie qui monte progressivement de déterminée à visiblement épuisée, caméra légèrement vacillante dans les dernières coupes pour correspondre à ses jambes tremblantes.

Character
CHASE — idole coréenne, vingtaine. Longs cheveux noirs en queue-de-cheval haute, peau lumineuse se couvrant progressivement d’une fine sueur au fil de la séance, grands yeux expressifs. Silhouette athlétique et fine. Haut de sport à manches longues modeste, jogging/leggings amples (bras et torse entièrement couverts), baskets, serviette autour du cou, aucun bijou.

Setting
Une salle de sport en soirée — rack à squats, machine de leg press, machine de leg curl, espace pour fentes près du mur miroir, fontaine à eau de l’autre côté de la salle, éclairage doux au plafond.

Storyboard (20 s, 8 plans)
(~2,5 s, caméra posée sur le rack à squats, plan moyen) Elle se tient debout, mains sur les hanches, en train de se motiver. CHASE : "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2,5 s, caméra posée, rack à squats) Elle fait quelques squats, respiration contrôlée, remet la barre en rack en expirant. CHASE : "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."
(~2,5 s, à la main, en marchant) Elle se dirige vers l’espace pour les fentes près du miroir, la caméra rebondissant légèrement. CHASE : "Onto lunges now, wish me luck."
(~2,5 s, plan moyen posé, fentes) Elle enchaîne quelques fentes marchées, vacille légèrement sur la dernière, riant d’elle-même. CHASE : "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2,5 s, caméra posée, machine de leg press) Elle s’installe sur la leg press, pousse sur une répétition, le visage crispé par l’effort. CHASE : "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2 s, insert macro, faible profondeur de champ) Gros plan sur ses mains agrippant les poignées de la leg press, la sueur captant la lumière. Aucun dialogue — uniquement les sons ambiants de la salle.
(~2,5 s, à la main, marche chancelante) Elle se relève, les jambes visiblement tremblantes, s’agrippant au rack pour garder l’équilibre, éclatant de rire. CHASE (en riant) : "Okay— my legs are actually shaking right now—"
(~3 s, selfie à bout de bras, fin) Elle s’appuie contre le mur près de la fontaine à eau, reprenant son souffle, sourire fatigué, pouce levé. CHASE : "Okay, never doing legs again — see you guys, going to go lie down somewhere."

ja.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mmテープのビデオカメラのような手持ち感。CHASE本人の視点で、自分でカメラを持って撮影している感じ。ときどきラック、ベンチ、マシンのコンソールに置いて撮る。手ブレ、フレーミングのズレ、遅れて入るフォーカス送り、不器用なズーム、たまに顔が切れる構図、完璧ではないショット。ビデオカメラ本体は画面に映らない。
LOOK:
柔らかく、少しぼやけたテープ質感、かすかなテープノイズ、ジム照明で白飛び気味のハイライト、ちらつくオート露出、控えめなコントラスト、自然な肌色。
STYLE:
遊び心のある、自虐気味のジムVlogトーン — 本気の努力、息の上がったコメント、自然な笑い。素早い手持ちカットで、最初は意気込みから始まり、徐々に明らかに疲れていく流れ。後半のカットでは、彼女の脚の震えに合わせてカメラも少し揺れる。
Character
CHASE — 韓国のアイドル、20代。長い黒髪を高いポニーテールにまとめ、セッションが進むにつれて汗で肌がつやめく。大きく表情豊かな目。細身でアスレチックな体型。控えめな長袖のアスレチックトップ、ゆったりしたジョガーパンツ／レギンス（腕と胴体は完全に覆う）、スニーカー、首にタオル、アクセサリーなし。
Setting
夕方のジム — スクワットラック、レッグプレスマシン、レッグカールマシン、鏡張りの壁の近くのランジ用スペース、部屋の向こう側にウォーターファウンテン、柔らかな天井照明。
Storyboard (20s, 8 cuts)
(~2.5s, propped camera at squat rack, medium shot) 彼女は立ち上がり、両手を腰に当てて気合を入れる。CHASE: "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2.5s, propped camera, squat rack) いくつかスクワットをこなし、呼吸をコントロールしながら、息を吐いてバーベルをラックに戻す。CHASE: "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."
(~2.5s, handheld, walking) 鏡の近くのランジ用スペースへ移動し、カメラが少し弾む。CHASE: "Onto lunges now, wish me luck."
(~2.5s, medium propped shot, lunges) ウォーキングランジを数回こなし、最後の1回で少しふらつき、自分で笑ってしまう。CHASE: "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2.5s, propped camera, leg press machine) レッグプレスに腰を下ろし、1回押し切る。顔に力が入る。CHASE: "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF) レッグプレスのハンドルを握る彼女の手のクローズアップ。汗が光を受けてきらめく。セリフなし — 環境音のみ。
(~2.5s, handheld, unsteady walk) 立ち上がると脚が目に見えて震えており、バランスを取るためにラックをつかみ、思わず大笑いする。CHASE (laughing): "Okay— my legs are actually shaking right now—"
(~3s, arm's-length selfie finish) ウォーターファウンテンの近くの壁にもたれ、息を整えながら、疲れた笑顔で親指を立てる。CHASE: "Okay, never doing legs again — see you guys, going to go lie down somewhere."

ko.content:
---
카메라:
DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더를 손에 들고 촬영한 듯한 느낌. CHASE가 직접 카메라를 들고 있는 1인칭 시점이며, 가끔 랙, 벤치, 또는 머신 콘솔 위에 올려둔다. 손떨림, 어긋난 구도, 늦게 따라오는 포커스 풀, 서툰 줌, 가끔 얼굴이 잘리는 프레이밍, 완벽하지 않은 샷. 캠코더는 화면에 절대 보이지 않는다.
룩:
부드럽고 약간 흐릿한 테이프 화질, 은은한 테이프 노이즈, 체육관 조명 아래서 번지는 하이라이트, 깜빡이는 자동 노출, 절제된 대비, 자연스러운 피부 톤.
스타일:
장난스럽고 자기비하적인 짐 브이로그 톤 — 진짜로 노력하는 느낌, 숨이 찬 코멘터리, 실제 웃음. 빠른 핸드헬드 컷, 의지가 넘치다가 점점 눈에 띄게 지쳐가는 흐름, 후반 컷으로 갈수록 다리의 떨림에 맞춰 카메라도 살짝 흔들린다.
캐릭터
CHASE — 한국 아이돌, 20대. 긴 검은 머리를 높게 묶은 포니테일, 세션이 진행될수록 땀으로 윤기가 도는 피부, 크고 표정이 풍부한 눈. 슬림한 운동 체형. 단정한 긴팔 운동 상의, 헐렁한 조거 팬츠/레깅스(팔과 몸통은 완전히 가려짐), 스니커즈, 목에 걸친 수건, 액세서리 없음.
설정
저녁의 체육관 — 스쿼트 랙, 레그 프레스 머신, 레그 컬 머신, 거울 벽 근처의 런지 공간, 방 건너편의 정수기, 부드러운 천장 조명.
스토리보드 (20초, 8컷)
(~2.5초, 랙에 올려둔 카메라, 미디엄 샷) 그녀가 서서 손을 허리에 얹고 스스로를 다잡는다. CHASE: "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2.5초, 랙에 올려둔 카메라, 스쿼트 랙) 몇 번 스쿼트를 한다. 호흡을 조절하며, 내쉬는 숨과 함께 바벨을 랙에 걸어둔다. CHASE: "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."
(~2.5초, 핸드헬드, 걸어가며) 거울 근처의 런지 공간으로 이동한다. 카메라가 살짝 튄다. CHASE: "Onto lunges now, wish me luck."
(~2.5초, 미디엄 고정 샷, 런지) 몇 번의 워킹 런지를 한다. 마지막 동작에서 살짝 휘청이며 스스로를 보고 웃는다. CHASE: "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2.5초, 랙에 올려둔 카메라, 레그 프레스 머신) 레그 프레스에 자리를 잡고 한 번 밀어 올린다. 얼굴에 힘이 들어간다. CHASE: "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2초, 매크로 인서트, 얕은 심도) 레그 프레스 손잡이를 꽉 쥔 그녀의 손 클로즈업, 땀이 빛을 받는다. 대사는 없음 — 체육관의 앰비언트 사운드만.
(~2.5초, 핸드헬드, 불안정하게 걸으며) 그녀가 일어서는데 다리가 눈에 띄게 떨린다. 균형을 잡으려 랙을 붙잡고, 웃음이 터진다. CHASE (laughing): "Okay— my legs are actually shaking right now—"
(~3초, 팔 길이 셀피 마무리) 정수기 근처 벽에 기대 숨을 고른다. 지친 미소, 엄지척. CHASE: "Okay, never doing legs again — see you guys, going to go lie down somewhere."
---

pt.content:
CAMERA:
Sensação de camcorder DV 16mm, filmado à mão. POV de CHASE segurando a câmera ela mesma, às vezes apoiando-a em um rack, banco ou console de máquina. Tremor de mão, enquadramento desalinhado, ajustes de foco atrasados, zooms desajeitados, enquadramentos ocasionalmente cortando o rosto, takes imperfeitos. O camcorder nunca aparece em cena.
LOOK:
Qualidade suave, levemente borrada, com aparência de fita, ruído sutil de tape, highlights estourados sob a iluminação da academia, autoexposição piscando, contraste suave, tons de pele realistas.
STYLE:
Tom divertido e autodepreciativo de gym-vlog — esforço genuíno, comentários ofegantes, risadas reais. Cortes rápidos com câmera na mão, energia crescendo progressivamente de determinada até visivelmente exausta, com a câmera levemente trêmula nos cortes finais para combinar com as pernas bambas dela.
Character
CHASE — idol coreana, 20 e poucos anos. Cabelo preto longo em um rabo de cavalo alto, pele luminosa ganhando um brilho de suor conforme a sessão avança, olhos grandes e expressivos. Corpo atlético e esguio. Top esportivo modesto de manga longa, joggers/leggings folgados (braços e torso totalmente cobertos), tênis, toalha no pescoço, sem joias.
Setting
Uma academia à noite — rack de agachamento, máquina de leg press, máquina de leg curl, espaço para lunges perto da parede espelhada, bebedouro do outro lado da sala, iluminação suave no teto.
Storyboard (20s, 8 cuts)
(~2.5s, câmera apoiada no rack de agachamento, plano médio) Ela fica em pé, mãos na cintura, se preparando mentalmente. CHASE: "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2.5s, câmera apoiada, rack de agachamento) Ela faz alguns agachamentos, respirando de forma controlada, recoloca a barra no suporte com um suspiro. CHASE: "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."
(~2.5s, handheld, caminhando) Ela vai para o espaço de lunges perto do espelho, com a câmera balançando levemente. CHASE: "Onto lunges now, wish me luck."
(~2.5s, plano médio apoiado, lunges) Ela faz alguns walking lunges, cambaleando um pouco no último, rindo de si mesma. CHASE: "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2.5s, câmera apoiada, máquina de leg press) Ela se acomoda no leg press, empurra em uma repetição, com o rosto fazendo força. CHASE: "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2s, insert macro, DOF rasa) Close-up nas mãos dela segurando as alças do leg press, suor refletindo a luz. Sem diálogo — apenas som ambiente da academia.
(~2.5s, handheld, caminhada instável) Ela se levanta, com as pernas visivelmente tremendo, segurando o rack para se equilibrar, caindo na risada. CHASE (laughing): "Okay— my legs are actually shaking right now—"
(~3s, selfie de braço estendido, final) Ela se encosta na parede perto do bebedouro, recuperando o fôlego, sorriso cansado, joinha. CHASE: "Okay, never doing legs again — see you guys, going to go lie down somewhere."

zh.content:
CAMERA:
DV 16mm 磁带摄像机的手持质感。CHASE 亲自拿着相机的 POV，偶尔把它架在器械架、长凳或机器控制台上。手部晃动、构图不稳、对焦延迟、笨拙的变焦、偶尔拍到脸部被切掉的构图、不完美的镜头。摄像机始终不出现在画面中。
LOOK:
柔和、略微模糊的磁带画质，轻微磁带噪点，健身房灯光下高光泛光，自动曝光闪烁，低饱和对比度，真实肤色。
STYLE:
轻松、带点自嘲的健身 vlog 语气——真切的努力、气喘吁吁的旁白、真实的笑声。快速的手持剪辑，情绪从坚定逐渐推进到明显疲惫，后半段镜头轻微晃动，以配合她发抖的双腿。
Character
CHASE — 韩国偶像，20多岁。黑色长发扎成高马尾，皮肤发亮，随着训练推进逐渐浮现汗意，眼睛大而有表现力。身材纤细、运动感强。朴素的长袖运动上衣、宽松慢跑裤/紧身裤（手臂和躯干完全遮住）、运动鞋、脖子上搭着毛巾、没有首饰。
Setting
傍晚的健身房——深蹲架、腿举机、腿弯举机、镜墙附近的弓步空间、房间另一侧的饮水机、柔和的顶灯。
Storyboard (20s, 8 cuts)
(~2.5s, propped camera at squat rack, medium shot) 她站着，双手叉腰，给自己打气。CHASE: "Okay, leg day — let's see how bad this gets."
(~2.5s, propped camera, squat rack) 她做了几次深蹲，呼吸控制得很稳，呼气时把杠铃放回架上。CHASE: "Okay, squats down — already feeling it."
(~2.5s, handheld, walking) 她走向镜子旁的弓步区域，镜头轻微晃动。CHASE: "Onto lunges now, wish me luck."
(~2.5s, medium propped shot, lunges) 她做了几次行走弓步，最后一下有点发飘，忍不住笑自己。CHASE: "Okay that last one was NOT cute—"
(~2.5s, propped camera, leg press machine) 她坐进腿举机，发力完成一次推举，表情吃力。CHASE: "Why did I save this one for last—"
(~2s, macro insert, shallow DOF) 特写她的手抓着腿举机把手，汗水在光线下闪着。无对白——只有健身房环境音。
